name: L_ShowESignRibbon
displayName: Allow the use of SharePoint eSignature for Microsoft Word (User)
description:
This policy setting allows you to control whether users can request eSignatures directly from Word in tenants that have enabled Microsoft's native eSignature service.

If you enable this policy setting, users can request eSignatures from within Word. This policy setting applies only to subscription versions of Word.

If you disable this policy setting, users cannot request eSignatures from within Word.

If you don't configure this policy setting, users cannot request eSignatures from within Word.

name: L_StopReadAloudEyesOffExperience
displayName: Stop Read Aloud when app goes in background (User)
description:
This policy prevents Read Aloud from reading text when app goes in background.

If you enable this policy setting, Read Aloud will be disabled and will stop reading the text when app is sent to background.

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, Read Aloud will continue reading the text when app moves to background and user will be able to control Read Aloud via notification.
